name: Muskum
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Extinct; Glottolog lists only classification refs (Barreteau & Dieu 2000, Tourneux); no grammar/phonology located.

sources.citation: Tourneux, Henry. 2022. Quelques touches historico-linguistiques sur la question "mousgoum". 11 pp. HAL halshs-03832384.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Muskum stress/accent/tone. pp. 3-5 recount the only two data sources: Mecklenburg's c.1910 'Muzgum-Stadt' vocabulary (published in Lukas 1937, re-used in Lukas 1941) and Tourneux's own 1976 elicitation from the last rememberer Lepeke (~100 vocables in a week, informant refused to repeat words), published as Tourneux 1977b; states muskum and munjuk were not mutually intelligible.

sources.citation: Gravina, Richard. 2014. The Phonology of Proto-Central Chadic. Utrecht: LOT 375.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 5.3.3 Musgum group: Muskum data = 276 lexical entries from Tourneux 1977, 'not a great amount of information available on the phonology or grammar'; the reconstruction explicitly excludes tone and stress. No Muskum stress statement.

sources.citation: Tourneux, Henry. 1983. Les emprunts en musgu. In E. Wolff & H. Meyer-Bahlburg (eds), Studies in Chadic and Afroasiatic Linguistics, 441-477. Hamburg: Buske. HAL halshs-00459625.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Munjuk (Musgu) loanword tonology (tone schemes of borrowings); Muskum not treated; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Tourneux, Henry. 1982. Recherches sur la langue "musgu". Lacito-Informations 13, p. 78 (3 pp.). HAL halshs-02388786.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Project note on Musgu dialects; no Muskum phonology, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Tourneux, Henry. 1978. Le mulwi de Mogroum (Tchad): phonologie, elements de grammaire. These de 3e cycle, Paris 3 (HAL tel-02372418; scanned held).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Describes Vulum/Mulwi (Musgu, musg1254), not Muskum; Mouskoun mentioned only as a walled Vloum town (sec. 1.4). Full-text search finds no statement on accent/stress even for Vulum; nothing on Muskum.

sources.citation: Adolf Friedrich Herzog zu Mecklenburg. 1912. Vom Kongo zum Niger und Nil, Bd. 1-2. Leipzig: Brockhaus (archive.org vomkongozumniger01meck / 02meck, scanned text).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Travel narrative through the Musgum area (vol. 1 pp. 161ff); no linguistic material; the expedition's Muzgum-Stadt word list is published in Lukas 1937, not here.
